entities.summary: Irish Republic, a political institution in Ireland during Union, Emancipation & the Great Famine (1852–1870). Grew from Great Famine (An Gorta Mór) and Great Famine begins with potato blight. Led to the emergence of Post-Famine Ireland & the Fenians.
